name: ioctl_userfaultfd
description: The ioctl_userfaultfd system call performs operations on a userfaultfd file descriptor to handle page faults in user space. It allows configuration of userfaultfd behavior and resolution of page faults for specified memory ranges.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor referring to a userfaultfd object

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: The operation to perform (e.g., UFFDIO_API, UFFDIO_REGISTER)

parameters.name: argp
parameters.description: Pointer to a data structure specific to the operation

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error and sets errno

errors.description: argp points to an invalid memory address
Invalid argument, unsupported operation, or userfaultfd not enabled
A mapping in the specified range is registered with another userfaultfd object
The calling process lacks CAP_SYS_PTRACE capability for certain features
Operation failed due to partial completion or interruption
The specified range is not valid or the process changed memory layout
The faulting process has exited (older kernels)
Failed to allocate memory for page table entries

versions: Linux 4.3 and later, with features up to Linux 6.6
